title: How to Export Falcon LogScale Logs
content_md: Send your query to the LogScale query API, POST /api/v1/repositories/ /query, and ask for application/x-ndjson: you get one event per line. The original log line sits in @rawstring, so one jq call turns the export back into raw logs. Alternatively, export logs directly from the LogScale UI as plain text, JSON or CSV. LogScale (formerly Humio) is built for high-volume log search, so it often holds the most complete record a team has. Prime Core has 23,747 detection rules for Falcon LogScale, mapped to 674 MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Below is how to get data out, sanitize it, and investigate it for free in LogTotal. This guide covers standalone LogScale, cloud or self-hosted. If you use LogScale inside the Falcon console as part of Next-Gen SIEM, the console and its APIs are different. Get Started For Free Before you start A token. Create an API token with permission to query the repository. Treat it like a password. Base URL and repository. Cloud customers use their region’s URL, such as https://cloud.us.humio.com. Self-hosted clusters use their own hostname. You also need the repository or view name. Retention. Each repository has its own retention. Check it before you promise anyone a week of history.
